page_title: TOU 1-1 ANG | Toulouse v Angers 20/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+9' Substitution. Esteban Lepaul (Angers) replaces Farid El Melali.

90+8' Denis Genreau (Toulouse) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the right post by a whisker. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.

90+7' Joshua King (Toulouse) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
90+4' An accurate cross finds its way to Ibrahima Niane (Angers) who sends in a bullet header towards the middle of the target from just outside the box, but the goalkeeper makes the save.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
90' Himad Abdelli (Angers) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
88' Denis Genreau (Toulouse) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
87' Joshua King (Toulouse) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Toulouse.
86' Toulouse failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

85' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the bottom left corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper. Toulouse get a corner.
85' Toulouse will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

85' Frank Magri (Toulouse) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The linesman points to the corner flag, Toulouse are going to take it.
83' Here's the change. Carlens Arcus leaves the pitch and Abdoulaye Bamba (Angers) comes on as a substitute.
83' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Shavy Babicka as he is replaced by Frank Magri (Toulouse).
83' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to substitute Jim Allevinah and he is replaced by Bamba Dieng (Angers).
82' Toulouse fail to score from a corner as Yahia Fofana (Angers) leaps to collect the ball.
81' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The ball is out of play. Toulouse win a corner kick.
80' Toulouse have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
79' Denis Genreau (Toulouse) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

78' Joshua King (Toulouse) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. Toulouse have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
76' Alexandre Dujeux prepares a substitution. Jean-Eudes Aholou is replaced by Pierrick Capelle (Angers).
74' Yahia Fofana (Angers) is yellow-carded.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Miha Zajc departs the field of play to be replaced by Denis Genreau (Toulouse).

73' The ball spins to Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) on the edge of the box. He hits across the ball and sends it goalwards, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.

72' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Yahia Fofana, who pulls off a comfortable save!
68' The game is interrupted now, Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
64' 1 - 1 Joshua King (Toulouse) latches onto a cross in the penalty area and fires the ball into the bottom right corner!
61' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Miha Zajc (Toulouse) gets booked.
60' Himad Abdelli (Angers) failed to score from the penalty kick.
58' Himad Abdelli (Angers) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
57' One of the Toulouse players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. PENALTY AWARDED to Angers!
57' Miha Zajc (Toulouse) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Willy Delajod blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
56' Carles Martinez has decided to make a change. Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) replaces Umit Akdag.
52' The cross into the penalty area from Farid El Melali (Angers) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
49' The resulting corner from Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is cleared.
49' Toulouse take the free kick with a short pass.
48' Jordan Lefort (Angers) commits a rough foul. Willy Delajod stops the game and makes a call.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+1' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

42' Miha Zajc (Toulouse) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
41' An attempted cross from Farid El Melali (Angers) is cleared.
38' The game is interrupted. Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
38' Great save! Ibrahima Niane (Angers) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Guillaume Restes.
36' Farid El Melali (Angers) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
35' It seemed like Farid El Melali (Angers) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
33' Umit Akdag (Toulouse) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
29' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.

28' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Toulouse.
25' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Toulouse, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
25' Carlens Arcus (Angers) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Willy Delajod had an easy-decision to make.
24' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Yahia Fofana is equal to the effort and makes a good save.

23' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) meets a cross from the flank and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box, but the ball flies high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
20' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
17' Farid El Melali (Angers) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
17' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul. Angers win a free kick.
14' Toulouse can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
14' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The ball goes out for a corner. Toulouse can continue in their attacking effort.
12' Farid El Melali (Angers) takes the corner which is cleared.
11' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Yahia Fofana.

10' Toulouse slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
7' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.

5' 0 - 1 What a wonderful finish! Ibrahima Niane (Angers) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and smashes the ball inside the right post. There are not enough superlatives to describe that goal.
4' A quickly taken corner by Angers.

4' Jim Allevinah (Angers) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Angers.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Angers will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Willy Delajod.
